rationale.n_local: RUNG 1, the lenient tier CLAUDE.md mandates: the family's own pre-declared grid size. Spliced in per-family by denominators_for(), never stored here.
rationale.n_mechanisms: RUNG 2. 52 persisted family_keys, minus 8 merged as re-runs / diagnostic re-tests / second universes of an existing mechanism, minus multi_signal_combination (weighted combinations of specs already counted) = 43 (re-measured 2026-09-09; 37 on 2026-09-06). A ROBUSTNESS TIER ONLY. Precedent: Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016) take 'a haircut to 113 factors' from 316 as a robustness check. NOT an estimate of independent trials: DSR Eq.(9) would need rho_bar = 0.9650 to justify 37, against a measured 0.0314.
rationale.n_effective: RUNG 3. Li & Ji (2005) effective-N on the real 481-spec correlation matrix = 169.007, a redundancy ratio of 0.35137, applied to the 1131-trial raw pool = 397 (re-measured 2026-09-09; 362 on the 1031-trial pool of 2026-09-06). ANTI-CONSERVATIVE by construction: Halle et al. (arXiv:1612.04535) show Li & Ji and Galwey do not control the FWER. A lower bound on the honest denominator.
rationale.n_raw: RUNG 4, the most conservative N measured: every distinct (family_key, trial_id) pair in cross_sectional_trial_results = 1131 on 2026-09-09 (1031 on 2026-09-06). Corroborated within 3% by DSR Appendix A.3 Eq.(9) N_hat = 1095.48 (96.9% of raw); Cheverud (2001) and Nyholt (2004) give 466.47 on the 481-spec matrix, i.e. 97.0% of the matrix's specs, as before.
